capabilities: Manage subjects, assignments, exams, projects, todos and absences with CRUD modals
Switch the active subject and show its code in the status bar
Generate notes from 18 template types into subject folders
Search all entity types from one modal
View analytics counts, 30-day trends and receive deadline notifications
extras: The manifest carries a notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's roadmap lists open issues such as hard-coded note numbering, non-configurable hourly notifications, no data import/export and no automated tests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an academic semester's courses, deadlines and attendance from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Acknowledgments - Obsidian and the Obsidian sample plugin

summary: Semester manager that stores subjects, assignments, exams, projects, todos and absences, with a dashboard, search, analytics and note templates.
